tooltip.essentialcraft5.ley_crystal.desc.en: Collected from ley vents in Hoanna, or from fallen ley shards during a ley storm.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.ley_crystal.desc.zh: 在海纳尔的地脉喷口空手右键收来的，地脉风暴里落下的晶体也能捡到。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.radiant_crystal..en: Mined from radiant clusters in the hottest spots of the Dreadlands and the Hoanna Desert. Mining them gives you a dose of radiation.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.radiant_crystal..zh: 恐惧之地和海纳尔沙漠辐射最重的地方长着辐晶簇，挖下来就是它。挖的时候会吃一口辐射。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.tide_crystal.des.en: Harvested from fully grown tide buds in the Magical Corrupted Land. They only grow at night during a spring tide.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.tide_crystal.des.zh: 魔力腐化之地的潮晶芽长满以后右键收的。芽只在大潮的夜里长。

tooltip.essentialcraft5.umbral_crystal.d.en: Harvested from ripe umbral clusters in the Shadow Corrupted Land. You get more at night or during Darkness.
tooltip.essentialcraft5.umbral_crystal.d.zh: 暗影腐化之地的影晶簇成熟时右键收的。夜里或黑暗天灾中收得多。
